Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the headquarters city of the Fireball Cinnamon Whiskey manufacturer as New Orleans. Fireball is produced by the Sazerac Company, whose global headquarters is located in Chicago, Illinois, not New Orleans. While the Sazerac Company does have a historical connection to New Orleans (founded by Jean-Louis Amedee Sazerac), the current corporate headquarters is in Chicago. Consequently, the entire subsequent search effort focused on the wrong city (New Orleans) rather than Chicago, leading to a solution based on the wrong entity.
